summary: Amenability of Armed Forces Tribunal orders to Article 226 writ jurisdiction; basic structure doctrine; judicial review under Article 226 preserved despite tribunal adjudication; Section 14 of Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007 read with Article 227(4); no bar to High Court writ jurisdiction absent legislative exclusion; Chandra Kumar and Kesavananda Bharati principles affirmed; Major General Shri Kant Sharma overruled to extent conflicting.
legal_provisions_cited: L. Chandra Kumar v. Union of India
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's jurisdiction under Article 226 maintained; impugned view in Major General Shri Kant Sharma confined to extent inconsistent with basic structure doctrine.
